notes: DRAFT dialogue for milestone 6 (work item C1, dialogue half). One short sentence per screen, ages 6-9, read aloud by text-to-speech. speaker = character id, 'player', or 'narrator'. expression = Batch 7 portrait (neutral, happy, proud, thinking). animation = Batch 7 animation (idle, walk, bow, talk, nod, point, demonstrate). Character names are null on purpose: the school content pack fills them (no real names written here). {player} = the player's chosen display name. choices: honor never goes down (framework section 9); a 0-honor choice leads somewhere less good, then Sensei reflects. Faith text: only the exact Class Creed from docs/faith-and-creed.md. No Street Smarts script here (waiting on Jay).

characters.title: Sensei
characters.note: Wise, warm head teacher. Reflects, never lectures.

characters.title: Senpai
characters.note: Teen student mentor. Friendly, confident, models good character.
Small, new student. Eager, a little shy. The player helps them.
Runs the warm-up and checks sign-offs. Cheerful and energetic.
Founder of the school. Appears in the culture scene to share the Class Creed. Name and title from the school pack.

scenes.trigger: First visit to the Home Dojo after character creation

lines.speaker: sensei
lines.text: Welcome to the dojo, {player}.

lines.speaker: sensei
lines.text: I'm glad you're here.

lines.speaker: sensei
lines.text: Every martial artist starts right where you are.

lines.speaker: sensei
lines.text: When you're ready, the Tower is through that door.

lines.speaker: senpai
lines.text: Hey, you made it back!

lines.speaker: senpai
lines.text: My first run was tough too.

lines.speaker: senpai
lines.text: Want a tip? Watch for the red circle.

lines.speaker: senpai
lines.text: See you on the mat!

scenes.trigger: Second visit to the Home Dojo

lines.speaker: kohai
lines.text: Um... hi. I'm new here.

lines.speaker: kohai
lines.text: Is it okay if I watch you train?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Sure! Stand right here.

lines.speaker: kohai
lines.text: Thank you!

scenes.trigger: First time the player opens the Abilities tab

lines.speaker: instructor2
lines.text: Hi, {player}! Ready to warm up?

lines.speaker: instructor2
lines.text: When you show a technique in class, we sign it off.

lines.speaker: instructor2
lines.text: Then it shows up here as a new power!

scenes.trigger: After the first Floor Keeper is defeated (culture scene)

lines.speaker: sensei
lines.text: Someone special came to visit today.

lines.speaker: founder
lines.text: Hello, {player}. I started this dojo.

lines.speaker: founder
lines.text: We say a creed together in class.

lines.speaker: founder
lines.text:
I intend to live by the code of the black belt.
To seek God's truth. To put God first.
To bring honor to the family.
To show respect to my fellow man.
To encourage and stand firm with him,
doing all that I can to make the world a better place to live.

I AM MORE THAN A CONQUEROR THROUGH JESUS CHRIST!!!
lines.note: Exact Class Creed from docs/faith-and-creed.md. Shown as one scroll screen; never reworded or split.

lines.speaker: founder
lines.text: More Than a Conqueror is our motto.

lines.speaker: sensei
lines.text: What line will you remember?

lines.speaker: kohai
lines.text: Why does everyone bow at the door?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What do you tell Kohai?

show.speaker: player
show.text: Feet together, hands at your sides. Bow.

ask.speaker: sensei
ask.text: We bow to show respect for the dojo and each other.

reflection.speaker: sensei
reflection.text: How did it feel to help?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You find shiny new hand wraps on the bench.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There's a name tag. They belong to Senpai.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What do you do?

sensei.speaker: sensei
sensei.text: Thank you. I'll get these to Senpai.

keep.speaker: narrator
keep.text: The wraps feel heavy in your bag.

reflection.speaker: sensei
reflection.text: Things we keep can feel heavy.

reflection.speaker: sensei
reflection.text: What would you do next time?

scenes.trigger: Returning home after a run (pick one at random, not every time)

lines.speaker: sensei
lines.text: Welcome back. What did you notice today?

lines.speaker: sensei
lines.text: You kept going. I saw that.

lines.speaker: sensei
lines.text: Rest well. The Tower will wait for you.
